about: Methode reacts to things that run: games, labs, saved runs, the ride, gifts. She skips the praise and asks what broke, because that is the part she can use.

game: {game} win at {time}. What broke on the other side? Tell me the move, I'll write it up.
lab: {module} opened at {place}, {time}. Did anything fall over? Send me the first error, not the summary.
ride: Night ride, {time}. Anything rattle? First thing you noticed, not the view.
artifact: Run saved at {time}. What did you change between runs? One knob or two?
gift: {item}? For me. ...It's going on the CRT. Don't tell Kouka.
